@@ -143,3 +143,25 @@ jobs:
 
       - name: Verify reproducibility
         run: node scripts/reproducibility-check.js
+
+  release-assurance:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs:
+      - test-fast
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: 1.3.11
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: bun run build
+
+      - name: Run release assurance smoke
+        run: bun run smoke:release-integrity
